title: Free Parking at Government Agencies' Car Parks
what_it_is: Free Parking at Government Agencies' Car Parks

sections.label: Sunday free parking car parks
sections.summary: The proportion of Government and Statutory Board car parks offering free Sunday parking fell from around 70% in 2005 and 2010 to around 55% currently, as agencies balance area parking demands.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In 2005 and 2010, around 70% of the Government and Statutory Board car parks offered free parking on Sundays.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Currently, the proportion is lower at around 55%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In assessing whether to provide free parking on Sundays, agencies have to balance the specific needs and parking demands of the area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, it may not be feasible to have free parking on Sundays in HDB car parks where there is high demand for parking from the local residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This is also the reason why the proportion of car parks with free parking on Sundays has come down over these years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Would the Government consider setting a goal for the non-HDB car parks to offer free parking on Sundays, given the benefits in terms of family bonding as well as possible stimulus to small businesses and heartland businesses that may benefit from such a move?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In planning for the parking charges for specific car parks, whether HDB or, as the Member had asked, for non-HDB car parks, we look at it not just at the macro level but also at the micro level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, we want to encourage as much free parking on Sundays as possible for the reasons the Member has stated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But if we look at car parks in specific areas, we need to manage the demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For example, season parking ticket holders may find it difficult to find car park lots in specific areas and we need to make sure that we provide and accommodate them.
